children: Landstar System reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.512B and net income of $48M for the 13 weeks ended September 26, 2026. Revenue rose 25% from the prior-year quarter, while diluted EPS increased to $1.42 from $0.56.
Revenue was $1.512B, compared with $1.205B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 25%.
Net income was $48.0M, compared with $19.4M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 148%.
Diluted EPS was $1.42, compared with $0.56 in the prior-year quarter. Prior-year EPS included a $0.66 impairment charge.
Revenue for the 39 weeks increased 15%, as revenue per load rose 15% and load volume grew 1%. Third-quarter revenue increased 25%.
Truck transportation revenue rose 17% over the 39-week period, with tighter capacity and higher fuel costs lifting rates; truck loads increased 1%.
Multimode revenue declined 10% over 39 weeks as ocean and air loadings fell, while rail intermodal revenue and loadings increased.
Landstar served customers through about 980 agents and more than 75,000 capacity providers, including 75,758 available truck providers.
Insurance costs increased amid unfavorable claims development, while cargo losses were linked to supply-chain fraud and theft.
